pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bahū patte sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bahū patte sannicayaṃ karissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.5: pattavaṇijjaṃ vā samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā karissanti āmattikāpaṇaṃ vā pasāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekapattaṃ dhāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekapattaṃ dhārethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.13: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekapattaṃ dhāressatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu atirekapattaṃ dhāreyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.17: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Ānandassa atirekapatto uppanno hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.2: āyasmā ca Ānando taṃ pattaṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.4: atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.8: ahañ c' imaṃ pattaṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa dātukāmo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.10: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti. atha kho āyasmā Ānando
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.13: navamaṃ vā bhagavā divasaṃ dasamaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.14: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.17.1: dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkā- mayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.7: tayo pattassa vaṇṇā, ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.8: ukkaṭṭho nāma patto aḍḍhāḷhakodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadūpiyaṃ vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.9: majjhimo nāma patto nāḷikodanaṃ gaṇhāti . . . vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.10: omako nāma patto patthodanaṃ gaṇhāti . . . vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.16: tena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.17: ayaṃ me bhante patto dasāhātikkanto nissaggiyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.23: ayaṃ patto itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyo saṃghassa nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.24: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.51: nissaggiyaṃ pattaṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.56: anto dasāhaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati bhijjati acchinditvā gaṇhanti vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissaṭṭhapattaṃ na denti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.3: na bhikkhave nissaṭṭhapatto na dātabbo. yo na dadeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā 'ti. ||4||
